manaNeeded: {8}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Mogis from the command zone by paying {2}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Mogis triggers, dealing 2 damage to them as they are unable to sacrifice a creature.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.
